questions.question: Confirm Mansur Gilmullin’s original authorship of this joke, or present it as an anonymous adaptation citing a public source that existed no later than 2011.

localizations.source: Confirm Mansur Gilmullin’s original authorship of this joke, or present it as an anonymous adaptation citing a public source that existed no later than 2011.
